name: sim-nifas-surabaya
description: Sistem Monitoring Kesehatan Ibu Nifas Surabaya (SIM-NIFAS)

scripts.setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env')) fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env');" && uv sync && uv run python -m app.db.prd_seed && pnpm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test:all: uv run python -m tests.prd_smoke_test && uv run python -m tests.smoke_test
